scope.population: Previously exposed fixed48 validation engineering records only.

interpretation: C minus R is signed descriptive difference, not a load-adjusted treatment effect.
Between-window median differences are unpaired differences of six-entry medians.
Telemetry brackets the entry and has a different boundary from entry_seconds.
Disk deltas are host totals, not process IO or query waiting time.
Collector elapsed is not removable observer overhead; gaps are not wait durations.
No interpolation, correlation, regression, significance test or causal attribution.

All six formal pairs in each window; warm entries and publisher stay separate. C-minus-R means greater candidate value, not necessarily worse load. CPU means describe the bracketing sample window, not exact entry boundaries; process CPU includes sampler work. No per-query interpolation, wall-minus-process-CPU wait estimate, collector subtraction, load adjustment, significance, correlation or causal attribution. No workload rerun or live sampling. Targeted raw load/timer verification only; prior output/workload audits are not rerun.
